DEPENDS_ON removal test: inverse-filtering's definition specifies parameter (1) as 'the estimated transfer function H(z) — typically a linear-prediction filter for the vocal tract.' The method operates by constructing H_inv(z) = 1/H(z) where H(z) is an all-pole model estimated via linear prediction. Remove linear-prediction and the technique loses its primary means of estimating the vocal-tract filter — the core input to the inversion. This is the same pairing already accepted for glottal-flow (which depends on linear-prediction).
